title: Engine Diagnostic References — 3.7L Duratec (227kW/301PS)
introduction: An engine concern needs a route into diagnosis before it needs a shopping list of parts. I start here by identifying which reference the concern calls for: basic mechanical diagnosis or driveability diagnosis. These directions apply to this engine configuration and provide that routing only. The referred material is needed for test preparation, measurements, interpretation and the next diagnostic branch.

edits.text:
For basic mechanical concerns, refer to Engine (303-00 Engine System - General Information, Diagnosis and Testing).

For driveability concerns, refer to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual.
edits.why: These referrals connect each concern category to its prescribed diagnostic information. The category selects the next reference; it is not a finding about which component has failed.
